occurrences.exact_quote:
| Disagreement | Which coordinate fails |
|---|---|
| **Saturn→Jupiter→Mars assigned to consecutive fifths** | Musical transformation. Geocentric order is distance, not fifth generation. Cronus's anchor does not propagate to siblings. |
| **"Cronus is at 12" without coordinate specification** | Address. 12 could be planetary position (Saturn, yes), fifth-index (undetermined), or sounding address (undetermined). Must be typed. |
| **Chinese pentatonic read as fifth-generation order** | Musical transformation. C-D-E-G-A ≠ C-G-D-A-E. Two sequences, not one. |
| **Aion placed anywhere in 0–12** | Address. Aion is the frame; counting it as a constituent fails the "encompassing whole" test. |
| **Any yin/yang orientation flip in a transformation** | Inherited function. Must be explicitly marked as reversal, not silently absorbed. |
